title: One blow-up of a represented cycle: boundary, mass measure, concentration and Hausdorff representation
statement: Let P, d ∈ ℕ, n := d + 1, Hⁿ = μHE[n], a ∈ ℝ^P, λ > 0, D := dilation a λ (y ↦ −λ⁻¹a + λ⁻¹y) and μ' := ofReal(λ^{−n})·D_#μ (ENNReal.ofReal(λ⁻¹ ^ n) • Measure.map D μ). Let Γ, Γ' ∈ 𝒟_n(ℝ^P) (GeometricCurrentOn univ n), μ a measure on ℝ^P, M ⊆ ℝ^P Borel, θ : ℝ^P → ℝ Borel and ζ : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) strongly measurable, such that ∂Γ = 0, μ(ℝ^P) < ∞, M_W(Γ) = μ(W) for every open W, μ = (Hⁿ⌞M) with density ofReal∘θ, θ > 0 on M, Γ(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)ζ(x)(ω(x)) dHⁿ(x) for every test n-form ω, and (h2) ∂Γ'(ω) = λ^{−d}·∂Γ(ω') for all test d-forms ω, ω' with ω'(y) = ω(D(y)) for all y; (h4) if Γ(ω) = ∫ ζ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all test n-forms ω, then Γ'(ω) = ∫ ζ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ'(y) for all ω; (h5) M_{D(W)}(Γ') = ofReal(λ^{−n})·M_W(Γ) for every W ⊆ ℝ^P. Then (P0) Γ(ω) = ∫ ζ(x)(ω(x)) dμ(x) for all ω; (P7) ∂Γ' = 0; (P1) μ'(K) < ∞ for every compact K; (P2) M_W(Γ') = μ'(W) for every open W; (P3) y ↦ ζ(a + λy) is μ'-a.e. strongly measurable; (P5) Γ'(ω) = ∫ ζ(a + λy)(ω(y)) dμ'(y) for all ω; (P6) μ'(ℝ^P ∖ blowUpMap a λ '' M) = 0; (P8) Γ'(ω) = ∫_{blowUpMap a λ '' M} (θ(a + λy)·ζ(a + λy))(ω(y)) dHⁿ(y) for all ω.
